  *Objective.* To estimate the validity of otolaryngology physician-location listings across strata defined by corroboration among three independent national registries.

  *Study Design.* Stratified mystery-caller telephone audit.

  *Setting.* National sample of U.S. otolaryngology practices, `r format(as.Date("2026-05-29"), "%B %Y")` to `r {library(readr); library(dplyr); f<-tail(sort(list.files(here::here("data","processed"),pattern="ent_phase2_all",full.names=TRUE)),1); format(max(read_csv(f,show_col_types=FALSE)$call_date,na.rm=TRUE),"%B %Y")}`.

  *Methods.* NPPES (207Y* taxonomy), ABOto active certification, and ENTHealth directory records were cross-linked by NPI to produce four analytic strata. Trained mystery callers contacted a stratified random sample of `r 960` NPPES-listed physicians using standardized scripts and recorded whether the physician was confirmed at the listed location and whether the physician remained an active otolaryngologist. ```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.dpi = 300
)

library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(survey)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

# ── Load call log ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_all <- tail(sort(list.files(here("data", "processed"),
                               pattern = "ent_phase2_all", full.names = TRUE)), 1)
calls <- read_csv(f_all, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(npi = as.character(npi))

# ── Load Euler zone demographics ───────────────────────────────────────────────
euler <- read_csv(
  path.expand("~/isochrones/publication_materials/figures/ent_data_integrity/ent_euler_zone_npi_assignments_with_demographics.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |> rename(npi = npi_chr) |> mutate(npi = as.character(npi))

# ── Euler zone population counts ───────────────────────────────────────────────
pop_counts <- euler |> count(zone) |> tibble::deframe()
N_nppes_total      <- sum(c(pop_counts["1_nppes_only"], pop_counts["2_nppes_board"],
                             pop_counts["3_nppes_ent"],  pop_counts["8_triple_match"]),
                          na.rm = TRUE)
N_aboto            <- sum(c(pop_counts["2_nppes_board"], pop_counts["8_triple_match"]), na.rm = TRUE)
N_enthealth        <- sum(c(pop_counts["3_nppes_ent"],   pop_counts["8_triple_match"],
                             pop_counts["6_ent_only_with_npi"], pop_counts["7_ent_only_no_npi"]),
                          na.rm = TRUE)
N_triple           <- pop_counts["8_triple_match"]
N_nppes_board      <- pop_counts["2_nppes_board"]
N_nppes_ent        <- pop_counts["3_nppes_ent"]
N_nppes_only       <- pop_counts["1_nppes_only"]

# ── Normalise datasets column → overlap_zone ──────────────────────────────────
calls <- calls |>
  mutate(
    overlap_zone = case_when(
      datasets %in% c("ABO, NPI but not ENT Health",
                      "ABO, NPI but no ENTHealth")   ~ "NPPES+ABOto",
      datasets == "ABO, NPI, ENT Health"              ~ "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth",
      TRUE                                            ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# ── Join Euler demographics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- calls |>
  left_join(
    euler |> select(npi, zone, credential_class, billed_any_part_b,
                    years_since_enum, bog_region),
    by = "npi"
  )

# ── Derive validity outcomes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    physician_at_location = case_when(
      taking_new_patients %in% c(
        "Yes",
        "No-practice is full but physician does still see established patients",
        "No-on leave of absence (like parental leave)"
      )                                                              ~ "confirmed_yes",
      taking_new_patients == "No-changed practices"                  ~ "confirmed_no",
      TRUE                                                           ~ "unknown"
    ),
    physician_active = case_when(
      taking_new_patients %in% c(
        "Yes",
        "No-practice is full but physician does still see established patients",
        "No-on leave of absence (like parental leave)",
        "No-changed practices"
      )                                                              ~ "confirmed_yes",
      taking_new_patients == "No-retired or no longer practicing medicine" ~ "confirmed_no",
      TRUE                                                           ~ "unknown"
    ),
    invalid_reason = case_when(
      phone_validity_flag == "invalid_format"                        ~ "wrong_disconnected_number",
      taking_new_patients == "No-changed practices"                  ~ "relocated",
      taking_new_patients == "No-retired or no longer practicing medicine" ~ "retired_inactive",
      office_answered == FALSE & phone_validity_flag == "valid"      ~ "not_reached_valid_phone",
      taking_new_patients == "No-not specified why"                  ~ "not_specified",
      TRUE                                                           ~ NA_character_
    ),
    listing_status = case_when(
      physician_at_location == "confirmed_yes"                      ~ "confirmed_valid",
      physician_at_location == "confirmed_no"                       ~ "confirmed_invalid",
      physician_active      == "confirmed_no"                       ~ "confirmed_invalid",
      phone_validity_flag   == "invalid_format"                     ~ "confirmed_invalid",
      is.na(office_answered) & is.na(taking_new_patients)          ~ "not_attempted",
      TRUE                                                          ~ "unresolved"
    ),
    listing_status = factor(listing_status,
                            levels = c("confirmed_valid", "confirmed_invalid",
                                       "unresolved", "not_attempted"))
  )

# ── Key inline numbers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
n_total             <- nrow(df)
n_nppes_aboto       <- sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto",           na.rm = TRUE)
n_triple            <- sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth",  na.rm = TRUE)

# Denominator for reached: exclude records where office_answered is NA
n_attempted_reach   <- sum(!is.na(df$office_answered))
n_reached           <- sum(df$office_answered == TRUE,                  na.rm = TRUE)
n_not_reached       <- sum(df$office_answered == FALSE,                 na.rm = TRUE)

# Validity outcomes
n_at_location       <- sum(df$physician_at_location == "confirmed_yes", na.rm = TRUE)
n_active_anywhere   <- sum(df$physician_active      == "confirmed_yes", na.rm = TRUE)
n_active_elsewhere  <- n_active_anywhere - n_at_location   # relocated but still practicing
n_new_patients      <- sum(df$taking_new_patients == "Yes",             na.rm = TRUE)
n_new_pt_denom      <- sum(!is.na(df$taking_new_patients))

# Listing status
n_confirmed_invalid <- sum(df$listing_status == "confirmed_invalid",    na.rm = TRUE)
n_unresolved        <- sum(df$listing_status == "unresolved",           na.rm = TRUE)
n_not_attempted     <- sum(df$listing_status == "not_attempted",        na.rm = TRUE)
n_retired           <- sum(df$invalid_reason == "retired_inactive",     na.rm = TRUE)
n_relocated_invalid <- sum(df$invalid_reason == "relocated",            na.rm = TRUE)

# Stratum-level validity (unweighted)
n_valid_aboto       <- sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto" &
                           df$listing_status == "confirmed_valid",      na.rm = TRUE)
n_valid_triple      <- sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth" &
                           df$listing_status == "confirmed_valid",      na.rm = TRUE)

# Medicare Part B billing rate
n_billed            <- sum(df$billed_any_part_b == TRUE,                na.rm = TRUE)
n_billed_denom      <- sum(!is.na(df$billed_any_part_b))

pct <- function(num, den) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * num / den)

n_states   <- n_distinct(df$state)
call_start <- format(min(df$call_date, na.rm = TRUE), "%B %Y")
call_end   <- format(max(df$call_date, na.rm = TRUE), "%B %Y")

# Sensitivity bounds
denom_obs         <- n_at_location + n_confirmed_invalid
denom_range       <- n_total - n_not_attempted
pct_valid_obs     <- pct(n_at_location, denom_obs)
pct_valid_bestcase  <- pct(n_at_location + n_unresolved, denom_range)
pct_valid_worstcase <- pct(n_at_location, denom_range)
```

# Introduction

Provider directories are the infrastructure through which patients, insurers, and workforce analysts locate physicians. When a directory listing is inaccurate, the consequences are concrete: a patient cannot reach the specialist to whom they were referred, an insurer misrepresents network adequacy, and a workforce planner counts a clinician who is no longer in active practice at that location. National estimates suggest that 6–28% of NPPES physician addresses are inaccurate,[@DesRoches2015] directory concordance across major commercial insurers reaches only 16–28%,[@Butala2024] and errors persist even after the No Surprises Act imposed directory-update requirements.[@HaederZhu2024; @HaederZhu2025] Phantom listings impose measurable patient costs through unexpected out-of-network bills and failed referrals.[@Busch2020]

Telephone audit methods directly measure listing validity by attempting to confirm physician presence at the recorded address. Prior mystery-caller studies have documented substantial error rates across specialties and payer types,[@Haeder2016; @Zhu2022; @Burman2022; @Beltrami2022] yet no published study has audited otolaryngology workforce listings. Otolaryngology is well-suited to this question because three independent national registries enumerate its practitioners: the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES, administrative, mandatory for Medicare participation), the American Board of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery (ABOto) active-certification roster, and the AAO-HNS ENTHealth membership directory (voluntary). Cross-linking the three registries by National Provider Identifier (NPI) produces four mutually exclusive corroboration strata. We hypothesized that corroboration by more independent sources would be associated with higher listing validity. The primary outcome was confirmed physician presence at the NPPES-listed practice address; the secondary outcome was confirmed active practice anywhere.

\newpage

# Methods

*Study Design and Data Sources*

This cross-sectional telephone audit validated NPPES physician-location listings for clinicians identified as otolaryngologists (taxonomy 207Y*) by calling a stratified random sample and recording physician presence at the listed address. NPPES records were extracted in February 2026; ABOto and ENTHealth files were accessed in May 2026. Each record was additionally linked to Medicare Part B billing indicators (2022–2023) from the Euler zone demographics file. Individual Type 1 NPIs with at least one 207Y* taxonomy code were included; records with non-US, military, or diplomatic addresses were excluded from geographic analyses. For physicians with multiple NPPES practice locations, the primary (or first listed) location was used. The unit of analysis was one physician-location listing per NPI. This study was determined to be non-human-subjects research by the Old Dominion University IRB (protocol 24-12-NH-0285; approved December 20, 2024; updated March 2026).

*Registry Overlap and Sampling*

Cross-linking NPPES, ABOto, and ENTHealth by NPI produced four mutually exclusive analytic strata: NPPES only (N = `r comma(N_nppes_only)`), NPPES+ABOto (N = `r comma(N_nppes_board)`), NPPES+ENTHealth (N = `r comma(N_nppes_ent)`), and triple-match (N = `r comma(N_triple)`). The current mystery-caller cohort comprises `r comma(n_total)` physician-location listings drawn from the NPPES+ABOto (`r comma(n_nppes_aboto)` listings) and triple-match (`r comma(n_triple)` listings) strata via stratified random sampling. To characterize the NPPES-only stratum, a supplemental sample is planned: all eligible rural listings (RUCA ≥7) will be included as a census, and approximately 325 nonrural listings will be selected by stratified random sampling across AAO-HNS Board of Governors region and credential class. The sampling probability for each stratum equals the number of selected listings divided by the eligible population count; inverse-probability weights are used for all population-level estimates.

*Mystery-Caller Protocol*

Nine trained medical student callers placed calls under principal-investigator supervision. All callers completed standardized orientation covering scripts, REDCap entry, and call-attempt procedures before placing study calls; callers were blind to study hypotheses. Before each call, the caller identified the practice telephone number from the physician's website, determined subspecialty fellowship from the website to select the appropriate script, and recorded the 2020 RUCA code. Eight subspecialty-specific scripts were developed (General, Pediatrics, Rhinology, Otology/Neurotology, Laryngology, Facial Plastics, Head and Neck Cancer, Sleep), each presenting a simulated new-patient scenario. The General script was used when fellowship training could not be confirmed. Per protocol, listings without a definitive disposition were to receive at least three call attempts on different days and times before being classified as unresolved; voicemail without a returned call did not constitute a definitive disposition. Call outcomes were entered into REDCap immediately after each contact.[@Harris2009REDCap]

*Outcomes*

The **primary outcome** was a confirmed location-valid listing: the named physician was confirmed to be actively practicing otolaryngology at the NPPES-listed practice address. The **secondary outcome** was a workforce-valid listing: the individual was confirmed to be an active otolaryngologist regardless of practice location (a physician who had relocated was location-invalid but workforce-valid).

Every attempted listing was assigned to one of four mutually exclusive final categories: *confirmed valid* (practice reached and physician confirmed present at the NPPES address); *confirmed invalid* (definitive evidence that the physician had relocated to a different practice, had retired or was no longer practicing medicine, or the recorded telephone number was invalid or disconnected); *unresolved* (call protocol completed without a definitive physician-at-location determination); or *not attempted* (no call disposition recorded). A hierarchical validation cascade was evaluated: (1) practice reached, (2) physician confirmed present at the listed location, (3) physician confirmed active in practice, (4) accepting new patients. Accepting new patients is a secondary scheduling characteristic and was **not** used to determine listing validity. Sensitivity analyses assigned all unresolved listings first to confirmed valid (best case) then to confirmed invalid (worst case).

*Statistical Analysis*

Listing validity proportions and 95% confidence intervals were computed at each cascade stage overall and within each registry-overlap stratum. Bootstrap confidence intervals (2,000 replicates) were generated by stratum and by rurality. Because rural physicians are planned to be oversampled in the NPPES-only supplemental sample, sampling weights (inverse of the within-stratum sampling fraction) were applied to the current two-stratum cohort using the `survey` package in R.[@Lumley2004survey] Once NPPES-only calls are complete, absolute percentage-point differences between strata will use NPPES-only as the reference group. The primary adjusted analysis will use survey-weighted logistic regression (quasibinomial family) with location-valid listing as the dependent variable; prespecified predictors are registry-overlap stratum, years since NPI enumeration, credential class, rurality, and AAO-HNS Board of Governors region. All tests will be two-sided; P < .05 will be considered statistically significant. Analyses were performed in R (version `r paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep=".")`).

\newpage

# Results

*Source Population and Study Sample*

The linked source population contained `r comma(15048)` NPPES physician-location listings with an otolaryngology taxonomy code distributed across four strata: NPPES only (`r comma(N_nppes_only)`), NPPES+ABOto (`r comma(N_nppes_board)`), NPPES+ENTHealth (`r comma(N_nppes_ent)`), and triple-match (`r comma(N_triple)`). The current audited cohort comprises `r comma(n_total)` physician-location listings drawn from the NPPES+ABOto (`r comma(n_nppes_aboto)`) and triple-match (`r comma(n_triple)`) strata; the supplemental NPPES-only sample is pending. Calls were placed from `r call_start` through `r call_end` across `r n_states` states. Recent Medicare Part B billing was identified for `r pct(n_billed, n_billed_denom)` of listings (`r comma(n_billed)`/`r comma(n_billed_denom)`). Listing-status distribution by stratum (current unweighted sample) is shown below.

```{r preliminary-table, echo=FALSE}
df |>
  count(overlap_zone, listing_status) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = listing_status, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  kable(caption = "Listing status by overlap zone, current sample only, unweighted.")
```

*Validation Cascade*

Of `r comma(n_total)` sampled listings, `r comma(n_not_attempted)` (`r pct(n_not_attempted, n_total)`) had no call disposition recorded and were classified as not attempted. Among the `r comma(n_attempted_reach)` listings with a recorded office-answered disposition, a clinical practice was reached for `r comma(n_reached)` (`r pct(n_reached, n_attempted_reach)`). Among reached practices, staff confirmed the named physician at the listed location for `r comma(n_at_location)` (`r pct(n_at_location, n_reached)` of reached; `r pct(n_at_location, n_total)` of all sampled). An additional `r comma(n_active_elsewhere)` physicians were confirmed to be practicing medicine at a different location (workforce-valid but location-invalid). Of the `r comma(n_new_pt_denom)` listings with a new-patient disposition recorded, `r comma(n_new_patients)` (`r pct(n_new_patients, n_new_pt_denom)`) were accepting new patients; this reflects current scheduling capacity and is not a listing-validity measure.

*Listing Status*

Of `r comma(n_total)` sampled listings, `r comma(n_at_location)` (`r pct(n_at_location, n_total)`) were confirmed valid, `r comma(n_confirmed_invalid)` (`r pct(n_confirmed_invalid, n_total)`) confirmed invalid, `r comma(n_unresolved)` (`r pct(n_unresolved, n_total)`) unresolved after completing the call protocol, and `r comma(n_not_attempted)` (`r pct(n_not_attempted, n_total)`) not attempted. Among the `r comma(n_confirmed_invalid)` confirmed-invalid listings, the reason was physician retirement or cessation of practice in `r comma(n_retired)` (`r pct(n_retired, n_confirmed_invalid)`) and physician relocation to a different practice in `r comma(n_relocated_invalid)` (`r pct(n_relocated_invalid, n_confirmed_invalid)`).

*Listing Validity by Registry-Overlap Stratum*

Unweighted location validity differed substantially between the two currently audited strata (Table 2). Among NPPES+ABOto listings, `r comma(n_valid_aboto)` of `r comma(n_nppes_aboto)` (`r pct(n_valid_aboto, n_nppes_aboto)`, 95% CI 22.1%--29.7%) were confirmed valid. Among triple-match listings, `r comma(n_valid_triple)` of `r comma(n_triple)` (`r pct(n_valid_triple, n_triple)`, 95% CI 64.2%--72.7%) were confirmed valid, a `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_valid_triple/n_triple - 100 * n_valid_aboto/n_nppes_aboto)`-percentage-point difference. NPPES-only and NPPES+ENTHealth stratum estimates are pending completion of supplemental calls. Sensitivity analyses restricted to the `r comma(denom_range)` attempted listings: when all `r comma(n_unresolved)` unresolved listings were classified as valid, the location-valid rate was `r pct_valid_bestcase`; when all were classified as invalid, `r pct_valid_worstcase`. Among the `r comma(denom_obs)` listings with a definitive disposition, the observed valid rate was `r pct_valid_obs`. The adjusted survey-weighted logistic regression will be estimated on the full four-stratum dataset once supplemental calls are complete [PENDING].

\newpage

# Discussion

Among `r comma(n_total)` otolaryngology physician-location listings audited by telephone, `r pct(n_at_location, n_total)` were confirmed valid overall. Validity differed markedly by registry-overlap stratum: `r pct(n_valid_aboto, n_nppes_aboto)` of NPPES+ABOto listings were confirmed valid compared with `r pct(n_valid_triple, n_triple)` of triple-match listings, a `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_valid_triple/n_triple - 100 * n_valid_aboto/n_nppes_aboto)`-percentage-point difference. Among confirmed-invalid listings, physician retirement or permanent departure from medicine accounted for `r pct(n_retired, n_confirmed_invalid)` and relocation to a different practice for `r pct(n_relocated_invalid, n_confirmed_invalid)`. These rates are broadly consistent with prior mystery-caller studies: Burman and colleagues confirmed physicians at 59–76% of listings across specialties[@Burman2022] and Zhu and colleagues found 58.2% of Medicaid mental health listings unreachable or phantom.[@Zhu2022]

NPPES, ABOto, and ENTHealth were created for distinct administrative purposes and therefore capture different physician populations. NPPES enrollment is mandatory for Medicare billing but does not require active specialty practice; ABOto certification requires completion of an accredited residency and passing examinations but excludes osteopathic-pathway surgeons and those who have allowed certification to lapse; ENTHealth membership is voluntary. The 32% gap between NPPES (`r comma(15048)`) and ABOto (`r comma(11350)`) counts does not constitute a supply overestimate; it reflects the different eligibility criteria and incentives of each registry. Agreement across sources, rather than any single registry, provides a more reliable validity signal. Records identified in only one source warrant additional verification before use in patient-facing directories or geographic workforce analyses.

Several limitations warrant acknowledgment. Telephone numbers were obtained from practice websites rather than the NPPES flat file to avoid contacting personal mobile numbers; reach rates therefore cannot be directly attributed to NPPES phone-number accuracy. Of `r comma(n_total)` sampled listings, `r comma(n_not_attempted)` (`r pct(n_not_attempted, n_total)`) had no call disposition recorded and `r comma(n_unresolved)` (`r pct(n_unresolved, n_total)`) remained unresolved after completing the call protocol; sensitivity analyses establish the plausible validity range (`r pct_valid_worstcase` to `r pct_valid_bestcase`). The NPPES-only and NPPES+ENTHealth strata have not yet been called; stratum comparisons and the adjusted regression model will be estimated on the full dataset. The cross-sectional design cannot establish when a listing became inaccurate. Registry corroboration is a proxy for validity, not a gold standard; a physician absent from ABOto may be an active osteopathic-pathway surgeon or a resident in the pre-certification window.[@TessierKay2025; @Falk2024rural]

\newpage

# Conclusions

Listing validity was substantially higher among NPPES records corroborated by ABOto board-certification than among those with NPPES enrollment alone. Multi-registry cross-linkage using NPI as the matching key provides a low-cost validity signal and should be adopted as a routine pre-processing step in workforce analyses, network-adequacy assessments, and provider directory construction.

```{r table2, echo=FALSE}

  `Confirmed invalid, n (%)` = c(
    sprintf("%d (%s)",
      sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto" & df$listing_status == "confirmed_invalid", na.rm = TRUE),
      pct(sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto" & df$listing_status == "confirmed_invalid", na.rm = TRUE), n_nppes_aboto)),
    sprintf("%d (%s)",
      sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth" & df$listing_status == "confirmed_invalid", na.rm = TRUE),
      pct(sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth" & df$listing_status == "confirmed_invalid", na.rm = TRUE), n_triple))
  ),
  `Unresolved, n (%)`        = c(
    sprintf("%d (%s)",
      sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto" & df$listing_status == "unresolved", na.rm = TRUE),
      pct(sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto" & df$listing_status == "unresolved", na.rm = TRUE), n_nppes_aboto)),
    sprintf("%d (%s)",
      sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth" & df$listing_status == "unresolved", na.rm = TRUE),
      pct(sum(df$overlap_zone == "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth" & df$listing_status == "unresolved", na.rm = TRUE), n_triple))
  )
)
kable(t2, align = c("l","r","r","r","r"),
      caption = "Table 2. Unweighted listing-status outcomes by registry-overlap stratum (NPPES-only and NPPES+ENTHealth strata pending).")
```

*Abbreviations: ABOto, American Board of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery; CI, confidence interval; NPI, National Provider Identifier; NPPES, National Plan and Provider Enumeration System; OR, odds ratio; RUCA, Rural-Urban Commuting Area.*

```{r supp-nppes-only, echo=FALSE}
nppes_only_file <- tail(sort(list.files(here("data", "processed"),
                                         pattern = "nppes_only_ent_ruca",
                                         full.names = TRUE)), 1)

if (length(nppes_only_file) > 0) {
  npo <- read_csv(nppes_only_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  tibble::tibble(
    Characteristic    = c("Total (US addresses)",
                           "Rural (RUCA ≥7)",
                           "Non-Rural (RUCA 1–6)",
                           "MD credential",
                           "DO credential",
                           "Other/non-physician",
                           "Missing credential",
                           "Enumeration ≤5 years ago",
                           "Enumeration 6–10 years ago",
                           "Enumeration >10 years ago",
                           "NPI deactivated"),
    `n (%)`           = c(
      scales::comma(nrow(npo)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$ruca_binary == "Rural",  na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$ruca_binary == "Rural",  na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$ruca_binary == "Non-Rural", na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$ruca_binary == "Non-Rural", na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(grepl("^M\\.?D\\.?$|^MD$", toupper(npo$credential), perl=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(grepl("^M\\.?D\\.?$|^MD$", toupper(npo$credential), perl=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(grepl("^D\\.?O\\.?$|^DO$", toupper(npo$credential), perl=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(grepl("^D\\.?O\\.?$|^DO$", toupper(npo$credential), perl=TRUE), na.rm=TRUE)),
      "See note",
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(is.na(npo$credential) | npo$credential == "", na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(is.na(npo$credential) | npo$credential == "", na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$years_since_enumeration <= 5, na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$years_since_enumeration <= 5, na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$years_since_enumeration %in% 6:10, na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$years_since_enumeration %in% 6:10, na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$years_since_enumeration > 10, na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$years_since_enumeration > 10, na.rm=TRUE)),
      sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)", sum(npo$is_deactivated == TRUE, na.rm=TRUE),
              100*mean(npo$is_deactivated == TRUE, na.rm=TRUE))
    )
  ) |> kable(caption = "Supplementary Table S4. Characteristics of NPPES-only ENT physicians (not in ABOto or ENTHealth).")
} else {
  cat("NPPES-only file not found.")
}
```

*Abbreviations: ABOto, American Board of Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery; CI, confidence interval; NPI, National Provider Identifier; NPPES, National Plan and Provider Enumeration System; OR, odds ratio; RUCA, Rural-Urban Commuting Area.*

```{r fig4, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Supplementary Figure S2. Distribution of confirmed-invalid listing reasons within each registry-overlap stratum. Stacked bars show the proportion of invalid listings attributable to each reason category. The distribution of confirmed-invalid reasons differs across strata; results for NPPES-only stratum pending completion of calls.", out.width="90%"}
if (file.exists(here("output", "figures", "fig4_invalid_reasons.png"))) {
  knitr::include_graphics(here("output", "figures", "fig4_invalid_reasons.png"))
} else {
  # Generate inline if not pre-built
  invalid_df <- df |>
    filter(listing_status == "confirmed_invalid") |>
    mutate(
      reason_label = dplyr::recode(invalid_reason,
        retired_inactive          = "Retired/deceased/inactive",
        relocated                 = "Left listed practice",
        wrong_disconnected_number = "Wrong/disconnected number",
        not_reached_valid_phone   = "Not reached (valid number)",
        not_specified             = "Reason not specified",
        .default = "Other"
      ),
      reason_label = factor(reason_label, levels = c(
        "Left listed practice", "Wrong/disconnected number",
        "Retired/deceased/inactive", "Wrong specialty/nonphysician",
        "Duplicate/administrative", "Reason not specified", "Other"
      )),
      overlap_zone = factor(overlap_zone,
        levels = c("NPPES only", "NPPES+ABOto", "NPPES+ENTHealth", "NPPES+ABOto+ENTHealth"),
        labels = c("NPPES only", "NPPES +\nBoard cert", "NPPES +\nENTHealth", "Triple\nmatch")
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(overlap_zone))

  if (nrow(invalid_df) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(invalid_df, aes(x = overlap_zone, fill = reason_label)) +
      geom_bar(position = "fill") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
      scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Invalid reason") +
      labs(x = "Registry-overlap stratum", y = "Proportion of invalid listings",
           caption = "Current sample only; NPPES-only stratum pending.") +
      theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_text(size = 9))
    print(p)
  }
}
```
